Set peak and off-peak rates once, and Voltris applies them automatically. Midday prices drop to pull people in; Friday night prices hold because demand does. Flip the switch and watch a Tuesday fill up.

Getting Started

Live this week, not next quarter.

Step 01

Connect what you already have

Link the payment processor you already run and import your schedule. Your rates, your accounts — Voltris plugs into your stack instead of replacing it.

Step 02

Set your bays, prices & rules

Lay out your lanes, bays and rooms on the drag-and-drop calendar. Add deposits, dynamic pricing, waivers and door access codes where you need them.

Step 03

Bookings run themselves

Customers book and pay online. Reminders go out, doors unlock, leagues check in, memberships renew — and the day closes itself across every location.

08

Questions

Do I have to switch payment processors?+

No. Voltris works with the stack you already run — Stripe, Square, Clover, Authorize.net, plus Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and Venmo. Payments and deposits are processed through your own accounts, on your rates.

Can Voltris really run my facility without staff on site?+

Yes — that's what the day sheet is built around. Customers book and pay online, receive a door access code with their booking, and get automated SMS and email reminders. Many indoor golf and axe throwing operators run early mornings and late nights completely staffless.

How does dynamic pricing work?+

You set peak and off-peak rates for each bay, lane, room or court. Voltris applies them automatically by time of day and day of week, so quiet midday hours fill at a discount while peak weekend slots hold their full price.

We have more than one location. Does it still work?+

Multi-location is built in. Every site's bookings, staff and schedules roll up into one manager view, and the day reconciles itself across all of them — while each location keeps its own pricing and rules.

What about leagues, memberships and regulars?+

All built in. League check-ins, brackets and standings update themselves; memberships bill on a recurring cycle; and points and hours cards give your regulars a reason to keep coming back.

My business isn't on the industry list. Can I still use it?+

Very likely. Beyond the headline industries, Voltris also serves rentals, campgrounds, clinics and shooting ranges — if your business books time in bays, lanes, rooms, courts or departures, the platform adapts to how you operate.
